Spring training transportation in Scottsdale & Phoenix

Scottsdale Sprinters drives groups to Cactus League spring training games — Salt River Fields at Talking Stick and Scottsdale Stadium in Scottsdale, and the ballparks across the East and West Valley — in a private chauffeured vehicle booked by the hour, from $125 an hour in the 6-seat Luxury SUV (Suburban) to $325 in the 56-Passenger Motorcoach. A 5-hour game day comes to $625 to $1,625 before 8% Arizona tax for the whole vehicle, about $29 to $164 a seat with the cabin full.

About this experience

Plan transportation around confirmed Cactus League game times, stadium access rules, ticketed entrances, and a scheduled return. Guests purchase tickets and admissions directly.

Highlights

  • Multiple stadiums if the schedule permits
  • Between-game stop subject to current rules
  • One group pickup and return plan
  • Cooler and beverage policy confirmed by vehicle
  • Current team schedules checked directly
  • Schedule built around confirmed game times

Itinerary

Example itinerary. Your confirmed schedule sets the stops and times.

  1. Pickup timed to the confirmed first game
  2. First ticketed game
  3. Post-game stop if lawful, approved, and within the service window
  4. Transfer to second stadium (optional)
  5. Dinner at nearby restaurant
  6. Scheduled return to the confirmed address

What this covers, and what it does not

We are a chauffeured transportation service. We are not affiliated with the Cactus League, any team or any ballpark, and we do not sell, hold or deliver tickets, parking passes or admission. Buy tickets from the teams and the league; we drive.

Game times come from the official Cactus League and team schedules. Send the confirmed games and we build the pickup, the wait and the return around them in writing.

Two games in one day

A two-game day is one hourly booking: pickup timed to the first game, the first ballpark, an optional stop, the drive to the second ballpark, dinner if you want it, and the ride home. Reserve 10 hours and you are billed for 9, because a booking of 7 hours or more does not bill one of its hours.

On the Executive Black Sprinter that is $1,305 before tax, about $93 a seat for 14. On the Party Bus (28 Pax) it is $2,250, about $80 a seat for 28. Stops inside an hourly booking are part of it; the route is confirmed once both game times and tickets are confirmed.

The ten Cactus League ballparks

The official Cactus League uses 10 stadiums for 15 MLB teams across the Phoenix area. Two are in Scottsdale; the rest are in the East Valley and the West Valley, and a two-game day is simplest between neighbours.

Which team plays where, and when, is the league’s to publish: check the official Cactus League and team schedules before you send the route.

  • Salt River Fields at Talking Stick — Scottsdale (7555 North Pima Road)
  • Scottsdale Stadium — Scottsdale, near Old Town
  • Sloan Park — Mesa
  • Hohokam Stadium — Mesa
  • Tempe Diablo Stadium — Tempe
  • Camelback Ranch — Glendale
  • Goodyear Ballpark — Goodyear
  • American Family Fields — Phoenix (Maryvale)
  • Peoria Sports Complex — Peoria
  • Surprise Stadium — Surprise

Drop-off and pickup at Salt River Fields

Salt River Fields’ own materials name the access road beside the grass-field lots, or the Centerfield Parking Lots, as the suggested pickup and drop-off areas, off its three entrances on Pima Road. Use those as the planning anchor, then follow event-day signs and staff for the actual vehicle movement.

After the last out, the group gathers at one pedestrian point first and the trip lead confirms the vehicle’s pickup before anyone walks toward traffic. The Salt River Fields arrival guide has the official sources.

Weekend games and the cancellation window

Saturday and Sunday games in the Cactus League window are major-event dates on our booking calendar, so they run on the 60-day major-event cancellation window. Weekday games follow the standard or large-group terms, depending on the size of the group. The rate is the same published table either way.

The booking step flags a major-event date before anything is paid, and our policies set out every window.

Choosing the vehicle

Fit decides first. The Luxury SUV (Suburban) seats 6; the 56-Passenger Motorcoach seats 56 and is the largest single vehicle we run, so a bigger group is two vehicles on one reservation.

Then the kind of day decides the cabin. The Executive Black Sprinter, Executive White Sprinter, Maybach Jet Sprinter, Maybach Shuttle Sprinter, Mini Bus (24 Pax), Grech Executive Mini Coach (27 Pax), Executive Mini Coach (29 Pax) and 56-Passenger Motorcoach give proper seating for a family, a company group or a golf-and-baseball trip. The Pink Hummer Limo, Party Bus (28 Pax), Limo Lounge Party Sprinter, Limo Party Sprinter (13 Pax) and Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter suit a group that wants the ride to be part of the fun, at their own rates.

Mobility and accessibility needs belong in the same message — a low step, a seat near the door, room for a walker, a wheelchair or a folding mobility scooter — because vehicles differ and it changes which one fits. Anything this page cannot answer, access, wait or return questions included, goes to the contact form or to (623) 986-6339.

Frequently asked questions

How much is a party bus to a spring training game?

The Party Bus (28 Pax) seats 28 at $250/hr with a 4-hour minimum: 5 hours is $1,250 before tax, ~$45 a seat with every seat filled. Arizona tax of 8% is added at checkout.

Can we go to two spring training games in one day?

Yes. It is one hourly booking covering both ballparks, confirmed once both game times and tickets are confirmed. 10 reserved hours bill 9: $1,305 on the Executive Black Sprinter, $2,250 on the Party Bus (28 Pax).

Where does the vehicle drop off at Salt River Fields?

The venue names the access road beside the grass-field lots, or the Centerfield Parking Lots, as its suggested pickup and drop-off areas. Event-day signs and staff direct the actual vehicle movement.

Do you sell spring training tickets or parking?

No. We sell transportation only. Tickets and parking come from the teams, the league and the ballparks; without a ticket we can still drive you, we simply cannot get you in.

What cancellation terms apply to a spring training weekend?

Saturday and Sunday games in the Cactus League window are major-event dates, so they run on the 60-day major-event cancellation window. Weekday games follow the standard or large-group terms. Every window is set out at our policies.
